name: Meridian procedural retrieval holdout v1
creation_policy: Authored independently of Atlas/Orion task prompts and frozen before any candidate evaluation. Visible synthetic fixtures with paired language structure are a procedural holdout, not a secret test or a representative sample of production repositories.

protocol.candidate_order: Rotate by query and reverse on repeat two; retain every run.
protocol.common_packer: Same installed context engine, project settings and fixture for both rankers.
protocol.session_state: Fresh empty session for every query/candidate/repeat; no stored memories.
protocol.caches: Shared warm operating-system/SQLite caches, no flush or cold-cache claim.
protocol.timing: Current-process CPU and wall time, search and context separately; no model calls.
protocol.percentile: Nearest-rank p95 over retained successful observations; median p50.
protocol.context_size: Measured compact UTF-8 JSON bytes and engine planning estimate; not model usage.
protocol.complete_body: Union of returned source intervals must contain every expected line, and each line must match the immutable fixture. A symbol name or graph reference is insufficient.
protocol.required_dependencies: Two direct helper implementations required by each primary body; imports, runtime/library semantics and transitive type declarations are outside this declared completeness judgment.
protocol.precision: Unique returned source files in required or optional-positive paths divided by all returned source files. Exhaustive judgments apply only to this designed fixture task scope; an unjudged file is not automatically irrelevant in a real coding task.
protocol.selection: Both current and legacy are eligible. Production selection must use development evidence; this fresh holdout validates the frozen choice and must not be used to tune it. Report all complete-body/dependency failures and precision, size, p50/p95 tradeoffs without hiding runs.
protocol.source_safety: Write/read/parse fixture text only; never execute, import or test indexed source.

# Meridian operations

Four independent domains share deliberately ambiguous release, extend and revoke operation names. Current source is under src/. Historical exports, read models and user guides do not drive lifecycle decisions.
files.docs/appointments/extend.md:
# clinic appointment hold: extend

In src/appointments/service.py, inspect extend and its policy calculation: a clinic appointment hold extension must stay within the maximum lifetime. Include the complete method, deadline helper, and persistence helper bodies so the update can be reviewed.

User guide for the clinic appointment hold: release, extend and revoke. The clinician decision belongs to current source. This page has no executable implementation.
